Baseline means, sample funnel, and sample composition

Source: R/models.R
did_baseline_means.Rd

Descriptive companions to merger_did() for the same sets.

Usage

did_baseline_means(
  data,
  k = 5L,
  spec = "margin",
  gap = 0L,
  keep = ~OTHER == FALSE,
  designs = did_designs(),
  outcomes = names(did_outcomes())
)

did_funnel(data, k = 5L, spec = "margin", gap = 0L, keep = ~OTHER == FALSE)

did_composition(
  data,
  k = 5L,
  spec = "margin",
  gap = 0L,
  keep = ~OTHER == FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A build_model_data() object.

k

Controls per treated unit.

spec

Matching specification: "margin" or "equity" (the names of health in build_match_data()).

gap

Largest calendar-year gap between a recipient and its controls (with a gap above 0, the models add tax-year fixed effects).

keep

A one-sided formula (or quoted expression or string), evaluated in data$units, that selects the treated units (e.g. ~ OTHER == FALSE & YEAR <= 2021L), or NULL for all.

designs

Designs to run, from did_designs().

outcomes

Outcome codes, from names(did_outcomes()).

Value

did_baseline_means(): mean of each outcome at t-2, by design and TREAT. did_funnel(): a step, n table from merger cases to the units and controls used. did_composition(): the number of treated units in each level of each breakout variable.
